update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.44 - Fix owned support deck auto-equip grid layout
Fixes --- - The owned support deck auto-equip now matches the actual 3x2 career-selection grid (5 owned slots + 1 friend slot) instead of a hardcoded 4-slot single row, so all configured owned cards get tapped into the correct slots. - Removed the OCR "already equipped" check for owned slots, since the grid renders card art with no name text to read; equipping now always taps and re-picks each slot, bounded by a fixed attempt cap.
